text: nope. all you did now is just create a 3rd segment. and i still dont see them [Image #10] Lol. also lets stop trying to rush through this, you know and i know that by looking at this its a fucking nightmare and cannot sustain, so why are we trying to shape it like it can. re-evaluate this entire side setup. having pills for props is a disaster and having a huge block for pasting svg strings when i have never pasted a single one in my life is a waste and there are many other ux things very wrong with the approach
resolution: Re-evaluated the editor's left side panel per the user's call to stop band-aiding it. Diagnosis: the panels were lifted from a wide pane into a narrow rail without rethinking hierarchy, so they're controls-first/content-last and bury the actual content. First piece delivered: the prop menu's unscannable wall of ~100 text pills became a paged PICTURE browser (PropBrowser.tsx) with flat cross-catalog search that brings matches into view (no page-hunting). Thumbnail rendering is not yet good — live Scene3D tiles are tiny/unrecognizable, so a proper model->image bake pipeline is handed off (handoff-20260625-193822). The other half — the FacePainter (paint/skins) redesign (kill the never-used NEON-from-SVG block, lead with the texture grid) — is blocked by another session's uncommitted edits to FacePainter.tsx and is on the horizon in the handoff. Committed a2b647c52, 52a0d0c90.
